name: Torres del Paine
definition: Torres del Paine National Park only, as confirmed by the owner. Select the SNASPE protected-area polygon containing the Paine core. Includes the Torres and Lago Grey park sectors; excludes Puerto Natales and the much larger Torres del Paine municipality. Publisher stripped feature names; identify the unique park polygon by fixed source checksum, known landmarks and its extent.
license: SNASPE_CHILE2026 public protected-area mirror; no explicit data license is provided in that mirror.

name: Fuji
definition: Mount Fuji and all Fuji Five Lakes. Use the connected Fuji mainland sector of the Ministry of Environment Fuji-Hakone-Izu park zoning geometry. Fill interior settlement/water holes to represent the complete geographic region, including Motosu, Shoji, Saiko, Kawaguchi and Yamanaka lakes. Excludes the disconnected Hakone, Izu Peninsula and Izu island sectors. This is a sourced regional display footprint, not a claim that filled interior areas have national-park protection.
license: Japan Ministry of Environment data, via kamataryo/nationalpark-map; Government Standard Terms of Use v1.0. https://github.com/kamataryo/nationalpark-map/blob/449e68d3e29e19c6c6082a90d80feb8491d962b1/topojson/LICENSE.md

name: Izu
definition: Izu Peninsula regional footprint: dissolve the 15 peninsula municipalities Numazu, Atami, Mishima, Ito, Shimoda, Izu, Izunokuni, Higashiizu, Kawazu, Minamiizu, Matsuzaki, Nishiizu, Kannami, Shimizu and Nagaizumi. Retains their coastal shape and larger coastal islands; omits display islets smaller than 0.01 km2. Excludes the distant Izu Islands, Mount Fuji and Hakone. Municipalities define an administrative approximation of the peninsula region, not a surveyed natural boundary. The published municipal GeoJSON flattened detached coastal parts into polygon ring lists; rebuild those rings as parts before dissolving and filling regional interior holes, so the mainlands of Numazu, Shimoda and Minamiizu are retained.
license: Japan MLIT National Land Numerical Information N03 (2020), via niiyz/JapanCityGeoJson. Government data terms and source attribution apply. https://github.com/niiyz/JapanCityGeoJson/blob/f163894b3b6acfe31e772da6fce87b13427d3b56/README.md

name: Lake Atitlan
definition: Lago de Atitlan waterbody shoreline only, as confirmed by the owner. Published LAGO01 polygon (source area 123.508 km2), converted from Guatemala Transverse Mercator ESRI:103598 to WGS84 using the projection definition published with the source viewer. Excludes the surrounding watershed, towns and volcanoes. Shoreline reflects the source observation rather than a claim of a live water level.
license: Published Lago de Atitlan waterbody geometry via lisandr3/atitlan-3d; the mirror does not declare an explicit data license.

name: Atacama
definition: San Pedro de Atacama desert destination region, as confirmed by the owner. Use the San Pedro de Atacama commune boundary as a sourced regional display approximation, covering the town, surrounding desert, salt-flat and high-altitude destinations. Excludes the broad Atacama Desert, Atacama administrative region, Calama and the coast. This is an administrative footprint for the San Pedro area, not a natural desert boundary.
license: Chile commune boundary mirror caracena/chile-geojson; no explicit data license is provided in that mirror.
